design.population: task1 development, 220 rows per seed (110 old, 110 current)
design.primary: global 77-label teacher-forced sum log-likelihood exact match
interpretation_limits: three seeds are seeded class orders from a shared pretraining/foundation lineage, not three independent pretrained initializations
request-matched arms can differ in physical optimizer steps and effective batch size
B32_LOW 960-to-3200 is an explicit dose extension, not a request-matched contrast
batch loss summaries are stream diagnostics, not fixed-cohort teacher-KL evaluations
no pooled token NLL/PPL or FLOP estimate is computed
